name: app-with-codegraph
install: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; command -v codegraph >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/main/install.sh | sh; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if [ -d .codegraph ]; then codegraph sync || true; else codegraph init || true; fi
